title: The differentiated Maxwell source closes on the same triangular principal tier

maxwell_source.current: j_nu=e Im<Qphi,D_nu phi> is gauge invariant and obeys partial_mu j^mu=0 on the smooth common core
maxwell_source.differentiated_form: partial^alpha j is a finite sum of pairings between D^beta Qphi and D^gamma Dphi, plus lower curvature commutators, with |beta|+|gamma|<=|alpha|
maxwell_source.principal_count: For |alpha|<=R, each high factor has combined derivative--charge order at most R+1 and is controlled by K1387's principal tier
maxwell_source.tame_bound: For integer R>=3, ||j||_(H^R)<=C_R Y_R^2 by H^R(T3) algebra and high-low tame product estimates
maxwell_source.maxwell_energy: Lorenz-gauge wave control gives d E_Max,R/dt<=C_R ||j||_(H^R) E_Max,R^(1/2)
maxwell_source.constraint: Current conservation propagates the differentiated Lorenz/Gauss constraint on every smooth common-core solution
maxwell_source.boundary: The estimate is a gauge-fixed high-regularity analytic control, not a closed nonlinear KT range, BFV quotient or source observation map
